requirements: Reconcile older claimed round-2 Linux executor and receipt before overlapping work. Verify exact fork head and contributor ancestry; retain commands, exits, logs and JUnit XML including counts and skips.

Run ./gradlew :solr:core:cleanTest :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.update.SolrCmdDistributorTest with recorded seed. Require testRetryReachesServerWhileAnotherClientStalls, testConcurrentErrorDrainRetainsEveryError, testSuccessfulResponseKeepsReplicationFactorAccounting, testRealRunnerCallbacksDoNotNeedClientMonitor, testErrorCallbacksDoNotClassifyRetries, testStallReportedWhileResponseBodyIsBlocked, testStalledClientIgnoresLateCallbacks, testFinishKeepsErrorsAfterStall and testStallKeepsErrorsFromOtherNodes to execute. Repeat network and concurrent cases with multiple seeds; run ./gradlew tidy and ./gradlew check -x test. Formatting changes require a committed successor and new gate.

Retain unchanged tests in executable old-production overlays and establish meaningful failures for callback retry classification, blocked-body fence, client-monitor callback, original finish lost-error and ordered-operation regressions. For bounded deadlock tests, require the intended bounded assertion or timeout after documented preconditions, not an unrelated harness timeout, compile failure or skip. Capture overlays and XML/logs.

Validate observable retry delivery, valid JavaBin RF/rollup, real network callbacks while the client monitor is held and concurrent drain test outcomes. The runner-monitor test simulates the monitor held by flush; separately verify an actual concurrent blockUntilFinished and real successful and failed network callbacks complete with bounded controlled synchronization. Prove atomic drain with a controlled append at the old snapshot/clear boundary; the repeated concurrent test alone is not deterministic fail-before proof.

Assess multiple stalled clients, late callbacks, RF and error attribution, queued writes after stall and replica recovery. Active runners are fenced, not cancelled; no clean verdict with unresolved material safety concern. Any repair or formatting changes require a new implementation and exact-head successor gate. No public comments.
verdict_policy: Pass requires every positive check and discriminating fail-before leg, no skips and no unresolved material correctness concern. Distinguish helper coverage from real integration.
